effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints csUSDC shares to `receiver`, computed from storage with floor rounding (assets * supply / totalAssets).
Interest accrues first and fee shares may be minted to the fee recipient, which sets the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Deposit: an exact USDC amount, the share ticker csUSDC, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many csUSDC shares the receiver gets; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' = csUSDC.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the share amount. ERC-4626 deposit has no minimum shares bound.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name USDC or the csUSDC shares the signer receives.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for csUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for csUSDC to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends USDC to the vault. The amount is computed from storage with ceil rounding (shares * totalAssets / supply), with no maximum bound.
The vault mints exactly `shares` csUSDC to `receiver`.
Interest accrues first and fee shares may be minted to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Mint: deposit asset USDC (no amount), the exact csUSDC shares minted, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 0: signer sends 2 units of USDC (0.000002 USDC); the screen shows 'Deposit asset: USDC' with no amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the USDC amount. ERC-4626 mint has no maximum assets bound.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. The USDC payment shows only as a raw field 'Deposit asset: USDC'. Case 0 reader: 'amount not shown on screen'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Pay USDC to mint csUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver} for USDC".

cases.notes: The signer sends 2 USDC units to the vault. The screen names USDC but no amount, and no amount can be shown. The 0.000000999 csUSDC shares go to 0xdEaD, not to the signer; the screen shows this correctly. The reader got the direction and asset right but not the amount.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault withdraws exactly `assets` USDC from Morpho markets and sends it to `receiver`.
The vault burns csUSDC shares from `owner`, computed from storage with ceil rounding.
When `owner` is not the signer, the call spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
formats.shown: Withdraw: an exact USDC amount, the receiver, and the owner whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many csUSDC shares the owner burns; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. No field shows the shares.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the share amount. A label such as 'Shares burned from' on `owner` would help.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not say that csUSDC shares are burned to pay out USDC.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC by burning csUSDC" and add an interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` csUSDC from `owner`; in case 1 the owner is the signer.
The vault withdraws USDC from Morpho markets and sends it to `receiver`. The amount is computed from storage with floor rounding, with no minimum bound.
When `owner` is not the signer, the call spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
formats.shown: Redeem: the exact csUSDC shares, the receiver, and the owner. The asset received is not named.

findings.title: redeem does not name USDC as the asset the receiver gets; mint shows it as a constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: fields are only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`. The mint format has `"value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`. Case 1: the signer receives 10580925 USDC units (10.580925 USDC); the reader wrote 'Which asset is paid out; the screen doesn't say'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 1: the signer receives 10.580925 USDC, which the screen does not show.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the amount. ERC-4626 redeem has no minimum assets bound.

cases.notes: The screen shows the burn of 9.978115270290955878 csUSDC correctly. The 10.580925 USDC that arrives is not shown, by asset or by amount. The reader guessed 'likely USDC' with no amount.
